messages:
maya: quick check — seeing span gaps at the service edge for some requests (gateway -> kvcache). Dashboard feels sparse, can someone point me to the right trace/logs? https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/traces :thinking:

oscar: which request/example trace ids? do gateway logs show traceparent being forwarded?

maya: grabbed one: trace 8e5f9a2c..., occurred ~2026-03-16T18:21Z. gateway logs show traceparent header present. downstream kvcache only has a server span and no children. logs live under /logs/api-gateway and /logs/kvcache for that window.

jun: could be sampler/progpagator mismatch — we switched to W3C tracecontext (traceparent) last quarter. if kvcache still using old propagator or a parent-based sampler that drops children, you'll see this. check OTEL_PROPAGATORS and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER envs.

sasha: FYI infra: we rolled a collector update earlier — infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-16 18:10:22 rolled otel-collector v1.12.3 -> v1.13.0. the new tail-sampling config tightened defaults.

maya: good catch. i'll reproduce by curling the gateway with a traceparent header and attach logs. in meantime, where should i look for the collector sampling config?

oscar: collector config is in infra/repos/observability/otel-collector.yaml (k8s configmap). there's also a helper dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/efgh/observability -> add a panel for 'spans per request by service' to spot where counts drop.

jun: quick debug steps: 1) verify propagators: OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext on both services; 2) set OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_always_on temporarily on kvcache to see if child spans reappear; 3) reproduce with curl including traceparent.

sasha: if collector tail-sampler is too aggressive we should relax it for internal traffic. i'll open a ticket to tune target_rate and decision window. also suggestion: add an alert for 'span-per-request drop' >30% 5m vs baseline.

maya: i'll run the repro now, paste logs and a short trace snippet here. if parent-based change fixes it we'll merge a short-lived env flip and follow with a PR to infra repo for safer defaults. thanks team :thumbsup:
